labels: One hand is raised above the student's head with fingers open, while the other forearm remains on the desk beside a closed workbook.; 한 손이 머리 위로 올라가 손가락이 펴지고 반대 아래팔은 닫힌 문제집 옆 책상에 놓인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: One hand is raised above the student's head with fingers open, while the other forearm remains on the desk beside a closed workbook.
aliases: 손들기와 책상 지지
